title: Inspect EUR byte00 RAM text substitution paths
changes: Trace the two local RAM text-substitution helpers and distinguish the authenticated short-string path from the live callback path.
validation: Wine e158-byte00-buffer-helpers-dis-wine-8bksdmpz identifies helper 0801738c calling short-string selector 08016648 and copy/expander 08019d98, and helper 08019e94 dispatching through table 371158.

Original parser jump-table inspection maps command bytes 25/72/67 to these substitution and formatter branches; prior E132 expanded-string screen found no literal 40 67 01 in the authenticated short catalog.
limitations: Callback index domain/output, out-of-catalog short selectors, parser reachability, generated text and ordinary byte00 use remain unproved; Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance measurement.
